reviews.review_description: I love this game dont get me wrong but when im talking with my hb and I have sum dim wit 7 year old knocking me out 24/7 it can get annoying so I highly suggest private servers, also add name tags and different colors. Its a pain to tell who is who when everyone is red.
I love it building is fun

The building mechanics with the fighting is all good, it's challenging the climb and it would be good if they added a jump button, the only thing I found bad about the game is the little bit of dulay when you move your limbs. And the only thing that needs really changed in my opinion is the building just by a little connecting parts just a little bit difficult at some point but that's the only thing that is really a problem for ME. But overall a great game

Can we go faster

Add colours

Server menu

cosmetics

sound

make the ragdoll mechanic better by making the knocked persons perspective better
This is a really fun game when it's not laggy. If the hand movement delay was fixed, this would be one of my top 15 games. But it did just release, so I can't be too harsh.
